description: miso_enrichment, published by Nuclear-Verification-and-Disarmament, extends Cyclus with a uranium-isotope enrichment facility and a reactor facility using Gaussian-process regression to estimate irradiated-fuel composition. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The reactor surrogate requires appropriate training data; selected input parameters can require source changes. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance.
